scope: 对实际发行候选检查权限拒写、满盘、库损坏、旧包与删除恢复、提交丢响应。

named_actual_cases.name: Actual isolated Windows file DACL denies writes and is restored in finally
SQLite max_page_count quota rolls back draft and wallet mutations without a partial transaction
Actual after_commit lost response is resolved by receipt query and exact command retry without another reward
Actual corrupted registered recovery source SHA refuses pointer replacement
Read-only upgrade source audit checks actual bytes and refuses an altered source
Failed migration transaction leaves a real migration copy and preserves live original bytes
Committed invalid migration schema is rejected on a separate copy without promoting original
Actually missing control file stops writes and restoring that same control retains deletion generation
Old-generation backup re-applies learning and draft deletions and discards an actual registered late response
Recovery interruption before pointer promotion preserves live state and leaves candidate for inspection
Actual corrupt original recovery reports backup sequence and missing newer draft and observation
Real child termination before commit preserves saved draft learning checkpoint and original reward
Real child termination after commit preserves new transaction and retry does not duplicate its reward
Mismatched content release and newer schema refuse writes without overwriting original database

evidence.scope: isolated Windows SQLite service/process/DACL matrix; no user profile mutation
not_run: Physical power interruption (child process kill is recorded separately)
Physical system disk-full (the actual SQLite max-page quota failure is a narrower isolated test)
Complete matrix through the exported executable and native failure UX
A different clean Windows machine and human recovery/IME/screen-reader validation
